culprit_citations.quoted_text: Distributions declared from net investment income to common shareholders (3) | ( 1.99 )

findings.detail: Distribution total uses 2.89 per share from the payment schedule, including a 0.90 per-share distribution declared in December 2024; current-year financial highlights show 2025 distributions declared from NII of 1.99 per share against NII of 2.02 per share.

rationale: F16 is a fund-level aggregate heuristic. The raw source decides the issue: table 11 totals payments made in 2025 at 2.89 per share, but row 3 is a December 2024 declaration paid in January 2025. The authoritative current-year financial highlights show only 1.99 per share of distributions declared from net investment income and 2.02 per share of net investment income. The flag is therefore a real extraction-period error: the distribution-rate numerator includes a prior-period declaration, causing the reported 9.4325% distribution rate to be overstated relative to the current-year source anchor of about 8.0%.
